title: Lamb and German Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with tender lamb and German-style vegetables, perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add carrot and potato and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir in German mustard and tomato paste (if using) and cook for 1 minute.
Add wine (if using) and cook until reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Add stew broth and bring to a boil.
Return lamb to the pot and cover.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs (if desired).
